In mathematics, the '''Boole polynomials''' ''s''<sub>''n''</sub>(''x'') are polynomials given by the [[generating function]]

:<math>\displaystyle \sum s_n(x)t^n/n! = \frac{(1+t)^x}{1+(1+t)^\lambda}</math>

<ref>{{Citation |last1=Roman |first1=Steven |title=The umbral calculus |volume=111 |year=1984 |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=JpHjkhFLfpgC |series=Pure and Applied Mathematics |location=London |publisher=Academic Press Inc. [Harcourt Brace Jovanovich Publishers] |isbn=978-0-12-594380-2 |mr=741185}}</ref><ref>{{Citation |last1=Jordan |first1=Charles |title=Calculus of Finite Differences |year=1939 |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=3RfZOsDAyQsC |publisher=Hungarian Agent Eggenberger Book-Shop, Budapest |isbn=978-0-8284-0033-6 |mr=0000441 |id=Reprinted by Chelsea 1965}}</ref>
